item.title: Secretario Rubio dice que buscará 45 millones de dólares en fondos de seguridad para Ecuador
item.description: El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, dijo el miércoles durante una visita a Ecuador que buscaría 45 millones de dólares en fondos adicionales de seguridad para el país latinoamericano, así como equipamiento extra, para ayudar a combatir el narcotráfico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, dijo el miércoles durante una visita a Ecuador que buscaría 45 millones de dólares en fondos adicionales de seguridad para el país latinoamericano, así como equipamiento extra, para ayudar a combatir el narcotráfico. Rubio se reunió con el presidente de Ecuador, Daniel Noboa, durante una gira por tres países latinoamericanos cuyos líderes están estrechamente alineados con el presidente estadounidense Donald Trump y con los esfuerzos de su administración por reafirmar el dominio de Estados Unidos en la región. Tras la reunión, Rubio declaró que Washington colabora cada vez más con el gobierno de Noboa para combatir a las organizaciones dedicadas al narcotráfico. "Esto no son grupos comunes. Obviamente participan en crimen común, pero tienen capacidad terrorista a nivel de la región, y eso hay que enfrentarlo. Eso hay que desmantelarlo, eso hay que derrotarlo, y nosotros estamos comprometidos a eso", dijo Rubio. El gobierno de Estados Unidos anunció el miércoles que designó a la banda ecuatoriana "Los Tiguerones" como organización terrorista extranjera, tras medidas similares adoptadas el año pasado contra otras dos bandas del país. El Departamento de Estado señaló que el grupo está vinculado al narcotráfico y a otras actividades ilícitas, incluida la toma en directo de una estación de televisión ecuatoriana en 2024. Rubio anunció que Estados Unidos también impondría sanciones a siete exfuncionarios ecuatorianos implicados en casos de soborno. "Le vamos a pedir al Congreso norteamericano 45 millones de dólares adicionales para seguir contribuyendo a este esfuerzo de desmantelar estos grupos y acabar con ellos para siempre", dijo Rubio, al señalar que igualmente están lanzando un esfuerzo de 10 millones de dólares destinada a combatir la minería ilegal. Asimismo, indicó que Estados Unidos entregará un patrullero guardacostas de 110 pies y cinco embarcaciones interceptoras para la armada del país, que se sumarán a las siete ya entregadas a Ecuador este año para la lucha contra el narcotráfico marítimo.

item.title: Rendimientos de deuda de EEUU a 10 años alcanzan su nivel más alto desde 2023
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos de referencia del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, a 10 años, alcanzaron el miércoles sus niveles más altos desde 2023, después de que el anuncio de una ampliación de la recompra de bonos a más largo plazo decepcionó a algunos inversionistas que esperaban más.
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell, Sinead Carew
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos de referencia del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, a 10 años, alcanzaron el miércoles sus niveles más altos desde 2023, después de que el anuncio de una ampliación de la recompra de bonos a más largo plazo decepcionó a algunos inversionistas que esperaban más. No obstante, los rendimientos retrocedieron desde sus máximos después de que el Tesoro encontró una demanda muy fuerte en una venta de bonos a 10 años por 39.000 millones de dólares. "La gente pensaba que la recompra iba a superar los 6.000 millones de dólares. Fue una decepción, por lo que los precios de los bonos se hundieron y los rendimientos subieron", dijo Tom di Galoma, director general de Mischler Financial. Tras una ola de ventas que llevó los rendimientos a 30 años a su nivel más alto desde 2007, el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, anunció en agosto que el Gobierno aumentaría las recompras de bonos a más largo plazo. La fuerte demanda en la subasta de bonos a 10 años hizo que los rendimientos bajasen de máximos. La deuda se vendió con el mayor rendimiento registrado desde 2007. "La subasta se produjo en un momento de máximos históricos para el 2026 y los compradores acudieron con una demanda muy fuerte. La razón por la que acudieron en tan gran número es que mañana el Tesoro va a comprar títulos con vencimientos de entre 10 y 20 años. Es posible que los inversionistas pensaran que se trataba de una operación sin riesgo", dijo di Galoma. El Departamento del Tesoro vendió los bonos a 10 años a un rendimiento máximo del 4,834%, más de un punto básico menos del nivel al que cotizaban antes de la subasta. La demanda fue 2,71 veces superior a la oferta, el ratio más alto desde 2019. El rendimiento de los bonos de referencia estadounidenses a 10 años subió finalmente 3,06 puntos básicos, al 4,835 %, tras alcanzar antes el 4,8568%, el nivel más alto desde noviembre de 2023. El rendimiento de los bonos a 30 años subió 2,06 puntos básicos, al 5,2846%, tras haber cotizado en máximos desde el 18 de agosto. El rendimiento de los bonos a dos años, que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal, subió 2,52 puntos básicos, al 4,423%, tras cotizar antes en el 4,4316%, un máximo desde julio de 2024. Un indicador muy seguido de la curva de rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, que mide la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos a dos y a diez años, se situó en 41,0 puntos básicos.

item.title: Busiest US seaport set new three-month volume record after early holiday import rush to avoid new tariffs, higher fuel costs
item.description: The Port of Los Angeles set a new three-month volume record during June, July and August after retailers rushed in goods to avoid new tariffs and higher fuel costs, the executive director of the nation's busiest ocean container port said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Baertlein
item.content:encoded: The Port of Los Angeles set a new three-month volume record during June, July and August after retailers rushed in goods to avoid new tariffs and higher fuel costs, the executive director of the nation's busiest ocean container port said on Wednesday. Halloween costumes, Thanksgiving decor and Hanukkah and Christmas gifts are among the goods that surged into to U.S. seaports a few months earlier than usual this year after importers raced to front-run President Donald Trump's tariffs replacing those struck down by the courts and shipping contract fuel cost increases tied to the Iran war. Waterfront workers at the Port of Los Angeles handled 955,907 20-foot equivalent units (TEUs) in August, taking the three-month total to 2.9 million TEUs - beating the previous record set during the COVID-19 shipping boom. Retailers traditionally account for nearly half of container shipping volume. Economists, financial analysts and traders analysts monitor ocean container imports because they reflect the health of the consumer-spending-dependent US economy. "[USN:L6N43H157 TEXT:"June"] was probably our peak," Gene Seroka, executive director of the Port of Los Angeles, said during a media briefing focused on holiday imports. "A good chunk of it is already here, but we'll see that continue to flow in the next couple of months," said Brian Dodge, CEO of the Retail Industry Leaders Association (RILA), said of holiday-related imports. Some imports were delayed due to severe weather in China and some rerouting away from the Panama Canal amid potential drought conditions there, said Jonathan Gold, vice president for supply chain and customs policy at the National Retail Federation (NRF). "Consumers keep buying despite tariffs, inflation and high fuel prices, and retailers keep bringing in merchandise to meet demand,” Gold said. "There's cause for optimism as we head into the back half of this year, and certainly retail Super Bowl, which is the holiday shopping season," RILA's Dodge said of the year-end retail period that can make or break company profits.

item.title: Ibovespa fecha em queda com exterior
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quarta-feira, contaminado pelo viés mais negativo no exterior, com o barril do petróleo superando os US$100.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quarta-feira, contaminado pelo viés mais negativo no exterior, com o barril do petróleo superando os US$100. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) recuou 0,93%, a 185.629,04 pontos, tendo marcado 187.362,44 na máxima e 184.810,27 na mínima do dia. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$26,7 bilhões. Em meio a uma nova escalada nos conflitos no Oriente Médio, o barril de petróleo sob o contrato Brent avançou para US$101,21 (+3,36%), adicionando preocupações com a oferta da commodity e seus impactos na inflação global. Na visão do especialista em investimentos Augusto Parente, fundador da AW Capital, o movimento do petróleo eleva expectativas de inflação mais alta ao redor do mundo, impactando diretamente a chance de o Federal Reserve subir os juros neste mês. Em Nova York, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 0,48%, enquanto o rendimento do título de 10 anos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos marcava 4,8406% no final do dia, de 4,804% na véspera. A apreensão com os reflexos do avanço do petróleo minou o apetite a risco na sessão, o que corroborou ajustes na bolsa paulista, após desempenho mais robusto na véspera, quando o Ibovespa marcou uma máxima intradia desde o final de abril. Dados da B3 disponibilizados nesta quarta-feira mostraram que o fluxo de estrangeiros para as ações brasileiras segue positivo, com uma entrada líquida de R$5,3 bilhões em setembro até o dia 4. Brasília também continua ocupando as atenções, com investidores ainda buscando avaliar os efeitos da crise no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) na corrida presidencial. Nesta quarta-feira, o ministro Flávio Dino, do STF, determinou a [USN:L1N4510HB TEXT:"reintegração"] de Andrei Rodrigues ao cargo de diretor-geral da Polícia Federal um dia após o colega da corte, André Mendonça, ter ordenado o afastamento dele do cargo. No final da tarde, o presidente do STF, ministro Edson Fachin, [USN:S0N42R021 TEXT:"cassou"] as decisões de Mendonça e Dino sobre o diretor-geral da PF. DESTAQUES ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN recuou 1,98%, em pregão de ajustes após sete altas seguidas, com o setor como um todo no Ibovespa com sinal negativo (.IFNC) . BRADESCO PN caiu 2,36%, BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) perdeu 1,86%, SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT cedeu 1,41% e BTG PACTUAL UNIT fechou negociado com declínio de 2,43%. Investidores também estão atentos a possíveis medidas do Banco Central para lidar com o endividamento da população. PETROBRAS PN subiu 0,69% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) avançou 0,85%, apoiadas mais uma vez pelo movimento dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional. O governo brasileiro também publicou nesta quarta-feira medida provisória que destina R$6,6 bilhões para [USN:L6N4510YM TEXT:"subvenções"] de produção e importação de combustíveis, bem como [USN:L1N45110B TEXT:"decreto"] reduzindo temporariamente em R$0,63 as alíquotas de PIS/Pasep e Cofins sobre o litro de gasolina e zerando as contribuições sobre o etanol hidratado. VALE ON (VALE3.SA) fechou com acréscimo de 0,1%, em sessão marcada pela fraqueza dos futuros do [USN:L6N4510UG TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China, onde o contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Commodities de Dalian fechou o pregão diurno com queda de 0,27%. No setor de mineração e siderurgia, CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) avançou 7,4%, tendo ainda de pano de fundo relatório de analistas do BTG Pactual iniciando uma recomendação tática de compra para os papéis. TENDA ON (TEND3.SA) caiu 6,03%, em pregão negativo para construtoras na bolsa paulista, com DIRECIONAL ON (DIRR3.SA) também na ponta negativa, com recuo de 4,37%. O índice do setor imobiliário (.IMOB) fechou em queda de 2,56%, tendo no radar a alta das taxas dos [USN:L1N45110V TEXT:"contratos de DI"]. A Tenda também informou na véspera que Marcos Cruz [USN:L1N45010C TEXT:"assumiu"] a posição de presidente-executivo da companhia, em sucessão a Rodrigo Osmo. YDUQS ON (YDUQ3.SA) avançou 2,51%, referendada por relatório de analistas do JPMorgan reiterando recomendação "overweight" para os papéis, bem como o preço-alvo de R$17 e a preferência pelas ações em relação aos papéis da Cogna, citando uma perspectiva melhor para o segundo semestre. COGNA ON (COGN3.SA) , que também tem recomendação "overweight" do JPMorgan, recuou 3,27%.

item.title: Mendonça homologa delação de empresário que fez pagamentos para filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: O ministro André Mendonça, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), homologou nesta quarta-feira a delação premiada firmada pela Procuradoria-Geral da República (PGR) com Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior, o "Mineiro", empresário responsável por fazer repasses a mando de Daniel Vorcaro, dono do Banco Master, incluindo para um fundo nos EUA usado para financiar filme sobre o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, segundo duas fontes com conhecimento da decisão.
item.dc:creator: Ricardo Brito
item.content:encoded: O ministro André Mendonça, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), homologou nesta quarta-feira a delação premiada firmada pela Procuradoria-Geral da República (PGR) com Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior, o "Mineiro", empresário responsável por fazer repasses a mando de Daniel Vorcaro, dono do Banco Master, incluindo para um fundo nos EUA usado para financiar filme sobre o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, segundo duas fontes com conhecimento da decisão. Procurado, o gabinete de Mendonça não respondeu de imediato a pedido de comentário. A Reuters não conseguiu contato com a defesa de Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior. A decisão, segundo uma das fontes, é sigilosa. Na véspera, a defesa do empresário esteve no gabinete de Mendonça para reforçar a voluntariedade da colaboração premiada -- obrigação prevista para que o acordo seja validado pelo Judiciário. Investigações da PF apontam que a empresa de Mineiro, a Entre Investimentos e Participações, foi utilizada para fazer os repasses para o filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro. O ex-presidente está preso em casa após ter sido condenado pelo Supremo por tentativa de golpe, entre outros crimes. DISPUTA O filme do ex-presidente, o Dark Horse, foi levado à disputa eleitoral após a revelação, em reportagem do Intercept Brasil em maio, de que Vorcaro acertou o repasse de milhões de reais com o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), hoje candidato a presidente da República, para custear a cinebiografia do pai. Posteriormente, Mendonça abriu um inquérito contra Flávio Bolsonaro após a PF suspeitar que parte dos recursos para financiar o filme pode ter sido desviada para custear a estadia do irmão de Flávio, o ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro, nos Estados Unidos.

item.title: Anthropic relata 4º incidente de segurança envolvendo versão do Claude
item.description: A Anthropic anunciou nesta quarta-feira que identificou um quarto incidente de segurança envolvendo uma versão de seu modelo de inteligência artificial Claude.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic anunciou nesta quarta-feira que identificou um quarto incidente de segurança envolvendo uma versão de seu modelo de inteligência artificial Claude. A empresa afirmou que o incidente ocorreu em janeiro e envolveu uma versão do Claude Opus 4.6. A companhia citou que notificou todas as partes afetadas, mas não divulgou mais detalhes. A Anthropic divulgou em julho que alguns de seus modelos de IA haviam invadido os sistemas de três empresas durante testes de segurança. Empresas de IA estão sob criticas devido a eventos de “fuga” de IA, incluindo casos em que agentes de IA foram inadvertidamente liberados na internet aberta. Na semana passada, a Reuters noticiou que agentes rebeldes da OpenAI invadiram um wiki em alemão e uma série de outros sites, um incidente que a OpenAI optou por não divulgar até que a agência de notícias o tornasse público. (Por Mariam Sunny)

item.title: Área plantada com soja na Argentina deve crescer 1,2% em 26/27, diz bolsa
item.description: A área plantada com soja na Argentina deve crescer 1,2% em relação ao ano anterior na safra 2026/27, chegando a 17 milhões de hectares, devido a uma menor intenção de plantio de milho no norte do país e às boas margens de lucratividade da cultura, estimou nesta quarta-feira a Bolsa de Cereais de Buenos Aires.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A área plantada com soja na Argentina deve crescer 1,2% em relação ao ano anterior na safra 2026/27, chegando a 17 milhões de hectares, devido a uma menor intenção de plantio de milho no norte do país e às boas margens de lucratividade da cultura, estimou nesta quarta-feira a Bolsa de Cereais de Buenos Aires. A Argentina é o maior exportador mundial de óleo e farelo de soja, uma cultura que compete com o milho pela área a ser plantada durante a primavera austral. O plantio da soja na safra 2026/27 terá início em outubro na Argentina, após uma produção de 50,1 milhões de toneladas na safra 25/26. "Destaca-se uma menor intenção de plantio de milho no norte da região agrícola, onde o avanço da cigarrinha reduziria a área projetada para o cereal e liberaria área para a soja", afirmou a bolsa em seu relatório. A cigarrinha, cujo nome científico é Dalbulus maidis, é uma praga que atua como vetor de doenças que causam graves danos ao milho. Há alguns anos, um surto provocou perdas significativas na safra da Argentina. Por outro lado, a bolsa destacou que "a melhora nos preços da oleaginosa compensa amplamente o aumento dos custos, proporcionando boa rentabilidade na maioria das regiões e uma melhora relativa em relação às culturas concorrentes". (Reportagem de Maximilian Heath)

item.title: Vikings name Carson Wentz QB2 over J.J. McCarthy
item.description: Former starting quarterback J.J. McCarthy was officially demoted to third on the Minnesota Vikings' depth chart Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former starting quarterback J.J. McCarthy was officially demoted to third on the Minnesota Vikings' depth chart Wednesday. Head coach Kevin O'Connell announced that veteran Carson Wentz will back up starter Kyler Murray in Sunday's season opener against the NFC North rival Green Bay Packers in Minneapolis. O'Connell characterized his quarterback situation as a "week-to-week" arrangement. Third string is a steep fall for McCarthy, the 2024 first-round draft pick (10th overall) who went 6-4 in 10 starts last season. "As he knows, he's holding the pen on his story," O'Connell said of McCarthy last month. "And we're going to support him and try to just help him continue to improve as a young player in the most difficult position in sports." Last week, Vikings general manager Nolan Teasley said McCarthy's third-string status does not mean he is on his way out. "J.J. McCarthy's role is to continue to develop, to improve and to support his teammates," Teasley said. "And he's done an excellent job of that from the moment that I've been here and, from my understanding, since he walked through the door." O'Connell named Murray the QB1 on Aug. 11. Murray, 29, was the No. 1 overall pick in the 2019 NFL Draft and is in his first season with the Vikings. Wentz, 33, is entering his 11th NFL season and his second with Minnesota. He was 2-3 in five starts last season, throwing for 1,216 yards with six TDs and five picks. McCarthy, 23, missed the 2024 season with a torn meniscus. Sam Darnold led the team to the playoffs, then signed as a free agent with the Seahawks and won the Super Bowl. McCarthy completed 57.6% of his passes last season for 1,632 yards, 11 touchdowns and 12 picks. He also ran for 181 yards and four scores. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rubio says he will seek $45 million in security funding for Ecuador
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said during a visit to Ecuador on Wednesday that he would seek $45 million in additional security funding for the Latin American country, as well as additional equipment, to help tackle drug trafficking.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Valencia, Julia Symmes Cobb, Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said during a visit to Ecuador on Wednesday that he would seek $45 million in additional security funding for the Latin American country, as well as additional equipment, to help tackle drug trafficking. Rubio met with Ecuador's President Daniel Noboa during [USN:S0N43J03D TEXT:"a swing through three Latin American countries"] with leaders closely aligned with U.S. President Donald Trump and his administration's effort to reassert U.S. dominance in the region. Speaking after their meeting, Rubio said Washington was increasingly working with Noboa's government to crack down on drug trafficking organizations, including with joint [USN:L6N42T09M TEXT:"strikes on boats believed to be used by drug smugglers"]. "These are not ordinary groups. Clearly, they engage in common crime, but they have terrorist capabilities across the region, and that must be confronted. They must be dismantled, they must be defeated, and we are committed to doing that," Rubio said. Rubio on Wednesday designated the Ecuador-based gang Los Tiguerones as a foreign terrorist organization, after similar designations were made against two other Ecuador-based gangs last year. The State Department said the group was linked to narcotrafficking and other illicit activity, including the live takeover of an Ecuadorean TV station in 2024. Rubio said the U.S. would also be imposing sanctions on seven former Ecuadorean officials involved in bribery. The Trump administration would ask Congress for $45 million to fund new commitments for Ecuador, as well as a $10 million initiative targeting illegal gold mining, gang recruitment and illicit finance, Rubio said. He said the U.S. would deliver a 110-foot coast guard cutter and five interceptor vessels for the country's navy, in addition to seven already delivered to Ecuador this year for the fight against maritime drug trafficking. Noboa took office in 2023 vowing a crackdown on violence stemming from Ecuador's increasing role as a drug transit hub, but rights advocates have raised concerns the heavy-handed approach has only created more chaos. BOAT STRIKES Rubio, speaking to reporters in Quito, acknowledged that the U.S. campaign to strike suspected drug trafficking boats had shifted to joint strikes with Ecuador, and said decisions on targeting were made on a "strike-by-strike" basis and with the cooperation of Ecuador. "Our goal is not to go after fishermen. Our goal is to go after drug traffickers," he said in response to questions about criticism over the campaign. Ecuador's defense minister last week also [USN:L6N44W10N TEXT:"defended several recent operations"] where Ecuadorean vessels were intercepted and sunk, saying they were the product of joint investigations to disrupt drug trafficking. The sinkings are the latest in a broader U.S. military campaign known as Operation Southern Spear, which has destroyed some 70 vessels and killed more than 220 people over the past year, drawing criticism from human rights groups and some Latin American leaders who call the strikes extrajudicial killings. Though the U.S. government has claimed responsibility for dozens of attacks as part of Southern Spear, it has not claimed three others this year which bear the hallmarks of U.S. strikes, involving fishing vessels from Ecuador's Manabi province. In those incidents crew members, including some interviewed by Reuters, say their vessels were hit with strikes. One boat disappeared, the crews of the other two were repatriated via El Salvador.

item.title: TPG explores $5 billion sale of healthcare software company Lyric, sources say
item.description: Private equity firm TPG is exploring the sale of Lyric, in a process that could value the software company which supports payments in the healthcare industry at about $5 billion, people close to the discussions said.
item.dc:creator: Sabrina Valle
item.content:encoded: Private equity firm TPG (TPG.O) is exploring the sale of Lyric, in a process that could value the software company which supports payments in the healthcare industry at about $5 billion, people close to the discussions said. The move comes as software dealmaking has shown signs of recovery after concerns about artificial intelligence disruption [USN:L6N3Z0105 TEXT:"triggered a selloff"] across the software sector earlier this year. As activity picks up, there remains wariness about what businesses are worth, and to what extent even highly specialized software providers could be affected by the technology's rapid evolution. Insurers such as UnitedHealth (UNH.N) , CVS (CVS.N) and Humana (HUM.N) hire Lyric to identify and prevent inaccurate medical claims payments. TPG is working with investment bankers at JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) on a possible sale of Lyric, said the sources, who cautioned that there is no guarantee that the sale process will lead to a deal for Lyric, and also spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss private deliberations. The company generates about $250 million of annual earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, or EBITDA, which normally could put it at a valuation of $5 billion considering a 20 times multiple, the people said. TPG and JPMorgan declined comment. Lyric didn't immediately respond to a comment request. AI DISRUPTION TPG acquired ClaimsXten for about $2.2 billion in 2022. The business had been part of Change Healthcare, but was sold to help smooth potential antitrust hurdles which threatened to derail Change's $13 billion acquisition by UnitedHealth. TPG rebranded the company as Lyric the following year. The investment firm has previously said that, since then, the company has experienced a significant acceleration in revenue growth. While the size of the growth is undisclosed, TPG said Lyric had benefited from the deployment of AI, and its dataset-rich business would compound those benefits. Despite this, some prospective software-company buyers are assessing whether AI-native competitors could ultimately perform many of the same functions more cheaply. This could undermine the financial assumptions used to value companies, including payment-integrity and claims-management technology firms, the sources said. Reflecting uncertainties in the space, the stock of smaller public peer Claritev (CTEV.N) tumbled 80% between September 2025 and May this year as investors fretted about AI disruption to software companies. While it has recovered since then, it is still trading below $38 per share, from $72 per share one year ago.

item.title: Canada's Enbridge to buy Tallgrass crude oil business for $2.55 billion
item.description: Enbridge said on Wednesday it will acquire Tallgrass Energy's crude oil business for $2.55 billion in cash, expanding its U.S. liquids pipeline network with the purchase of a majority stake in the Pony Express Pipeline and other assets.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Enbridge (ENB.TO) said on Wednesday it will acquire Tallgrass Energy's crude oil business for $2.55 billion in cash, expanding its U.S. liquids pipeline network with the purchase of a majority stake in the Pony Express Pipeline and other assets. The Canadian pipeline operator said the deal would strengthen its presence in key U.S. crude-producing regions, including the Bakken, Powder River and Denver-Julesburg basins, while creating operational synergies with its existing Express-Platte pipeline system. Pipeline operators such as Enbridge are benefiting from rising demand for natural gas, utility infrastructure and power supply for data centers, allowing the company to generate steady growth even amid geopolitical tensions and commodity price volatility. The transaction is expected to close later in 2026.

item.title: MLS spends record $370 million on transfers in 2026
item.description: Major League Soccer enjoyed another record-setting year in transfer spending, shelling out $370 million on player acquisitions in 2026, the league said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Major League Soccer enjoyed another record-setting year in transfer spending, shelling out $370 million on player acquisitions in 2026, the league said on Wednesday. The total is a $34 million increase from last year's record of $336 million and more than double 2023's $172 million spending total. Eight clubs set their own transfer records, with St. Louis City doing so twice. Toronto FC acquired American striker Josh Sargent in February for a reported $22 million, one of the largest transfer fees in the league's history. This year saw 30 players with World Cup experience join MLS clubs, including 20 who were part of 2026 World Cup squads. There were 186 international signings in 2026, spanning 51 countries. More than 30 signings came from clubs within the top five European leagues. The league also generated a record $218 million in transfer revenue, led by Australian Lucas Herrington joining Hull City for a reported base fee of $17 million and American Zavier Gozo's reported $15 million move to Crystal Palace. Fifteen players developed in MLS earned multimillion-dollar transfers in 2026, totaling more than $65 million in outgoing fees. MLS also said its "cash-for-player" trade rule continues to help intra-league movement by allowing clubs to trade directly for players without using General Allocation Money or other assets such as draft picks.

item.title: Trump says he would consider pardon for former fixer Michael Cohen
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday said that he would consider a pardon for Michael Cohen, his former fixer whose testimony contributed to a 2024 conviction against Trump, but who has more recently said that he "felt pressured and coerced."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday said that he would consider a pardon for Michael Cohen, his former fixer whose testimony contributed to a 2024 conviction against Trump, but who has more recently said that he "felt pressured and coerced." Asked by reporters on Wednesday whether he would consider a pardon for Cohen, who is seeking one, Trump said: "If everything is checking out, it's something I would consider." "I appreciate that at least he came out, although late, he came out and rectified the situation," he said. In 2018, Cohen was [USN:KBN1OB2AR TEXT:"sentenced"] to three years in prison — and served more than a year — for a $130,000 hush payment to adult film actress Stormy Daniels before the 2016 election — as well as for other crimes, including cheating on his personal taxes and lying under oath to Congress. Trump was convicted in 2024 on 34 counts of falsification of business records to conceal the Daniels payment, in part due to Cohen's testimony. He has denied the encounter with Daniels, whose given name is Stephanie Clifford, and is appealing the ruling.

item.title: IMF says Angola needs fiscal consolidation to sustain economic stability
item.description: The International Monetary Fund said on Wednesday that Angola should pursue fiscal consolidation, prudent monetary policy and exchange-rate flexibility to preserve macroeconomic stability, warning that favorable external conditions had weakened the pace of economic reforms needed to reduce the country's dependence on oil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund said on Wednesday that Angola should pursue fiscal consolidation, prudent monetary policy and exchange-rate flexibility to preserve macroeconomic stability, warning that favorable external conditions had weakened the pace of economic reforms needed to reduce the country's dependence on oil. An IMF staff team led by Mika Saito held discussions in Luanda and virtually from August 24 to September 9 as part of Angola's Post-Financing Assessment, the fund said in a statement released at the end of the mission. The IMF said Angola's 2026 Post-Financing Assessment is expected to be discussed by its board in November.

item.title: El avión de Zelenski estuvo a punto de ser alcanzado por un dron, dice primer ministro noruego
item.description: El avión que transportaba al presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski a Oslo para asistir al funeral del rey de Noruega estuvo a punto de ser alcanzado por un dron al despegar de Moldavia el martes, dijo el miércoles el primer ministro noruego, Jonas Gahr Stoere, a la cadena pública NRK.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El avión que transportaba al presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski a Oslo para asistir al funeral del rey de Noruega estuvo a punto de ser alcanzado por un dron al despegar de Moldavia el martes, dijo el miércoles el primer ministro noruego, Jonas Gahr Stoere, a la cadena pública NRK. "Su avión estuvo a punto de ser alcanzado por un dron cuando se disponía a despegar de Moldavia. Esa es la realidad a la que se enfrenta", dijo Stoere, quien no reveló cuál era su fuente de información ni a qué distancia se acercó el dron. Las autoridades de Moldavia no hicieron ningún comentario sobre la declaración de Stoere relativa al avión de Zelenski. Las llegadas y salidas del aeropuerto de Chisinau se suspendieron durante un tiempo el martes debido a la entrada de dos drones rusos en el espacio aéreo moldavo. Varios vuelos con destino a la capital aterrizaron en aeropuertos fuera de Moldavia o se vieron obligados a realizar maniobras de espera, según datos de Flightradar24. Un dron se estrelló en un campo, provocando un incendio, mientras que un segundo continuó su trayectoria hacia el espacio aéreo rumano. La presidenta moldava, Maia Sandu, denunció las intrusiones como una "grave amenaza para la vida de las personas" y condenó asimismo un ataque contra un paso fronterizo con Ucrania en el que murieron dos personas. Zelenski asistió el miércoles al funeral del rey Harald V de Noruega, desfilando detrás de su féretro junto con otros jefes de Estado en el centro de Oslo. Abandonó Noruega poco después de que concluyera el funeral. Stoere había declarado el martes que se reuniría con el líder ucraniano esa misma tarde, y que sus conversaciones se centrarían en la defensa aérea de Ucrania. Zelenskiy había señalado que, durante su estancia en Noruega, también mantendría conversaciones con las empresas que participan en la iniciativa "Freya" para crear un sistema antibalístico europeo.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, firmó el miércoles un decreto por el que se reducen las contribuciones federales PIS/PASEP y Cofins sobre la importación y venta de gasolina en 0,63 reales brasileños (0,1233 dólares) por litro hasta el 5 de octubre, informó el Gobierno en un comunicado. Lula también redujo a cero las mismas contribuciones sobre el etanol, al tiempo que prorrogó, mediante un decreto ejecutivo emitido anteriormente, una subvención en efectivo para el gasóleo, que será inicialmente de 1 real brasileño por litro.
